sheetsIndicative.note: one worksheet ('Sheet1'): header Value,Status,Type,Reserved to Date,Original start date,Licence type then 147,877 data rows. Status vocabulary Allocated (96,936), Reserved (50,627), Available (305) and blank (9); Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row. Licence type carries the product vocabulary (Full 53,699, Foundation 29,246, Intermediate 12,291, Club 1,658, Temporary Reciprocal 39) with 50,944 blank. Original start date populated on 96,869 rows (1903-05-03 to 2021-04-21); Reserved to Date populated on 123 rows (2019-03-23 to 2023-04-19). Header case differs from the January-2021 annex (Original start date / Licence type here).

raw-extract-sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Value,Status,Type,Reserved to Date,Original start date,Licence type then 147,877 rows. Anomalies preserved verbatim: one Value is empty (blank call sign, Reserved); one is literally ',,' (two commas, Reserved); 'G6 FMU' has an interior space; three Values carry a trailing non-breaking space (G0TQK, G7IWE, 2E1HON); two are lower-case (g0jrk, 2e1GTD); 475 four-character call signs (two-letter-suffix heritage series) and 91 call signs of six to nine characters, most of them reciprocal 'M/...' forms including curiosities such as M/#PT2FM, M/#YO3IES and M/EI-8-DJ. Dates arrive typed and are rendered ISO (date-only; no time-of-day components).

normalised--sheet-1-sheet1.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,reserved_to_date,original_start_date; 147,877 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning - not callsign-sorted, dates not monotonic). Status carried verbatim (9 blanks preserved); licence_class carries the source product vocabulary verbatim (50,944 blanks); reserved_to_date and original_start_date carried as ISO from the typed workbook. The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. Three trailing non-breaking spaces were trimmed from callsigns (counted in the converter notes, never silent); the empty Value, the ',,' Value and the interior-space 'G6 FMU' are preserved verbatim. The empty callsign sorts first, then ',,'.
